newsitem.title: USA: CBOT new crop corn seen 2-4 cents up, July lower.
newsitem.headline: CBOT new crop corn seen 2-4 cents up, July lower.

text.p: CBOT new crop December corn futures were called to open two to four cents per bushel higher on Monday, keying off of a cut in USDA's 1997 corn plantings estimate, traders said.
Old crop July corn was seen opening steady to two cents lower on USDA quarterly stocks figures that came in above trade expectation.

USDA on Monday estimated 1997 corn plantings at 80.2 million acres, below analysts' expectations for 81.8 million acres. But USDA put June 1 stocks of corn at 2.495 billion bushels, above trade expectations for 2.478 billion.
Project A was down 1-1/4 cents to up 1/4 cent.
